items.title: Preston Jackson Interview, 1973-09-07
items.q: And so Joe went to work with Dave Payton, who later on I worked in this band too.

ctx.x: Well, I never did know whether she could have been married then as far as I knew. Yeah. But Joe had several women pianists. It seemed like there was more women pianists who played that type of music than the men. Now there was a pianist up there from here called Arthur Campbell too. He played with George Field in the spot. And later on, fellas like Tom Aladdin came up and Mutt was up there for a while. And they came up, I think Mary Mack, like Mary Mack had, they played at the Monogram Theater. And so they began…
Did you ever see Big Jim Coliseum around?

items.title: Preston Jackson Interview, 1958-06-02
items.q: Joe Oliver, he went in with Dave Payton at the plantation.

ctx.x: Yeah, Kelly Stables. And Joe Oliver, he went in with Dave Payton at the plantation. So I visited first one place or another, and Louis Armstrong, by that time Louis left the band and went to New York to join Fletcher Henderson I think. And then Louis goes and joins Fletcher Henderson. And then Ori comes up to join Joe Oliver and he had Bob Schaffner and Tick Gray on trumpets. And he had the same Charlie Jackson on bass, bass horn, and he had Albert Nichols and Bonnie Bigard on the- and Darnell Howard. Well…
